title: Sanchalan Suktam parsing rules
source: Sanchalan Suktam V1.0, supplied source, explicitly not guaranteed final executable version
status: Closed lexical/parser grammar. Not a complete Sanskrit grammar or OS runtime.

productions.meaning: A program has numbered verse bodies terminated by double-daṇḍa numeric markers.
Normalize to NFC and use Unicode code-point offsets over normalized verse text.
At each offset choose the longest lexicon entry.
Unmatched spans are retained verbatim and make a verse lexically partial.
Duplicate or gapped numbering produces diagnostics and is not silently repaired.
Status describes lexical coverage only; it is not grammatical validity.

non_goals: claim that V1.0 is final executable source
